Billed amount: $980.00

Denied amount: $370.00

Adjustment reason: CARC 45 — Charge exceeds fee schedule/maximum allowable or contracted fee.
The denial of $370.00 reflects the difference between the billed amount and the allowed amount.

Appeal rights: a reconsideration may be requested within 120 days of the remittance date where the
provider believes the procedure was miscoded or the fee schedule applied was incorrect.

claim_id.description: Find the claim number or claim identifier the payer assigned, exactly as written.

date_of_service.description: Find the date of service the denial refers to, exactly as written.

carc_code.description: Find each claim adjustment reason code (CARC) applied, exactly as written, for example "CARC 16".

billed_amount.description: Find the total amount billed, expressed as written, including the currency symbol.

allowed_amount.description: Find the allowed amount, expressed as written; if the payer allowed nothing, return the zero amount as written.

appeal_deadline.description: Find the last date on which an appeal may be filed, as written; compute it only if the letter states a filing window in days from the letter date.
